ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70% high-intensity (white) pixels to 30% low-intensity (black/dark-brown) pixels across the visible ventral surfaces.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large white contiguous regions occupy the central fields of both lobes. Low-intensity pigmentation is concentrated at the fluke-to-peduncle junction, the central notch vertex, and along the entire perimeter of the trailing edge serrations.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch with an estimated pixel angle of 45-50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations (sawtooth pattern) ranging from 3 to 15 pixels in depth along the continuous trailing boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory on the trailing edge of both lobes, terminating in sharp, slightly curved distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small dark circular pixel clusters (mottling) scattered on the white field of the right lobe; potential barnacle attachment sites visible as high-contrast specks.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Prominent intersecting linear pixel disruptions forming an 'X' pattern on the central white field of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct 'X' shaped abrasion on the left lobe; irregular, jagged distal tip on the right lobe indicating potential historic structural loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly pronounced and deep serration morphology along the trailing edge relative to standard smooth-edge profiles.
